name: Obi
tagline: An overnight Obsidian housekeeper that files your notes and leaves a closing summary.
description: Works while you sleep: any vault import left half-finished gets wrapped up, and your daily notes land in the right month folder instead of piling up at the root. Before morning it writes a short end-of-day note recapping what it tidied and what still needs your eye.
author: bobpickettsr
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
